component.name: LinkShot
component.summary: Screen capture, scrolling capture, video recording and an image editor

description.p: LinkShot captures regions, windows, full screens and whole scrolling pages at native resolution, records the screen to animated GIF or MP4, extracts text from images, and edits captures with arrows, callouts, shapes, text, highlights, blur, steps, effects and more.
Everything needed is included: video export and text recognition work out of the box.
